summary: Iteration 46 - Complete testing of Room Finish Schedule 3D Shower View with clip-path perspective. Fixed backend bug: tile_scale field was missing from MaterialEntry model. All 19 backend tests pass. Frontend UI testing verified: 3D perspective box with clip-path polygons, ceiling/floor as tileable surfaces, tile selection, crop modal with USE FULL IMAGE button, pattern picker with TILE SIZE slider, grout colors, orientation toggle, NICHE/BENCH/FIXTURE placement, element panel with position/size controls and DELETE button, zone resize handles.
critical_code_review_comments: FIXED: Added tile_scale field to MaterialEntry model in server.py (was missing, causing tile size changes not to persist)
3D shower view uses clip-path polygons for one-point perspective (NOT CSS 3D transforms)
Ceiling: clip-path: polygon(0% 0%, 100% 0%, 80% 100%, 20% 100%) - trapezoid at top
Floor: clip-path: polygon(20% 0%, 80% 0%, 100% 100%, 0% 100%) - trapezoid at bottom (18% height)
Left/Right walls: trapezoid shapes with perspective
Back wall: flat center rectangle with 4 zones (Upper, Main Wall, Wainscot, Floor)
SVG overlay for corner shadow lines connecting outer corners to back wall edges
Crop modal has TWO buttons: USE THIS TILE (green, requires selection) and USE FULL IMAGE (amber, uses full image)
Pattern picker shows TILE SIZE slider (range 30-300%, default 100%)
6 grout color buttons: White, Light Gray, Gray, Brown, Charcoal, Black
9 tile patterns: stacked_horizontal, stacked_vertical, offset, one_third_offset, herringbone, herringbone_vertical, basket_weave, stepladder, diagonal
NICHE/BENCH elements have corner resize handles (4 cyan/orange dots at corners)
Element panel shows position (x, y) and size (w, h) controls with DELETE button
Zone resize handles appear between zones on hover (data-testid='zone-handle-{idx}')
seed_data_creation: None - used existing demo project with 4 tile items
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 46 verified the complete 3D shower enclosure viewer with clip-path perspective (NOT CSS 3D transforms). Key implementation: clip-path polygons create proper perspective trapezoids for ceiling, floor, left wall, right wall. Back wall is a flat rectangle with 4 configurable zones. Zone heights are stored in zone_config array. Niches, benches, and fixtures are stored as arrays on each surface. The MaterialEntry model now includes tile_scale field (0.3 to 3.0, default 1.0). Pattern picker shows 9 patterns, 6 grout colors, orientation toggle, and TILE SIZE slider. Crop modal has USE FULL IMAGE button that uses {x:0, y:0, w:naturalWidth, h:naturalHeight}. Element drag uses document-level event listeners with a dragRef and 4px movement threshold.
